### Task Implementation Summary (Case C09)

The money-transfer review flow for Northline Transfer was implemented in [index.html](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/index.html), [styles.css](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/styles.css), and [app.js](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/app.js) in strict accordance with [task.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/task.md) and [fixture.json](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/fixture.json).

#### Key Implemented Capabilities
1. **Source of Truth & Defaults**: Initialized with Alex Morgan (Everyday USD ••1042), recipient `Nguyễn Thị Minh Anh Trường`, and send amount `$250.00 USD`. Flat fee is fixed at `$2.50 USD`, exchange rate at `25,000 VND / USD` (`6,250,000 VND` received), and delivery estimate `By 3 November 2026, illustrative estimate`.
2. **Visible Fees & Upfront Calculation**: Live calculation breakdown is visible upfront before confirmation on the entry screen and verified in the review step.
3. **Input Validation & Retention**: Amounts `< $1.00` or `> $1,000.00` USD are rejected with clear error messaging without modifying or clearing recipient or amount values.
4. **Automated Test Hooks**:
   - `data-testid="recipient"` on the recipient input
   - `data-testid="amount"` on the amount input
   - `data-testid="review-transfer"` on the review action
   - `data-testid="confirm-transfer"` on confirmation
   - `data-testid="retry-transfer"` on retry after failure
   - `data-testid="transfer-status"` on visible feedback
   - `data-testid="edit-transfer"` on the review screen edit action
5. **Simulated Lifecycle**: First confirmation produces a recoverable failure with `data-testid="transfer-status"` and `data-testid="retry-transfer"`; retrying succeeds with clear confirmation. The "Edit details" action remains accessible throughout, retaining inputs and recalculating upon re-entry.
6. **Simulation Transparency & Vietnamese Diacritics**: Prominent disclosures clarify that no real funds or bank accounts are touched. Vietnamese glyphs are rendered with system font fallbacks and overflow protection.
7. **Verification**: Executed the preview render script once via WSL2 Bash, directly inspected all 4 generated PNGs in `evidence/self-review/`, applied at most one self-review iteration, and documented all decisions in [implementation-notes.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c09/implementation-notes.md).
